standard.summary: 智能训练控制器，根据 loss、CLIP 漂移、梯度秩等指标自动调整学习率、触发早停或冻结文本编码器。适合长时间无人值守训练。
standard.effect: 开启后训练器在后台持续监控训练健康状态，自动响应平台期/崩溃/收敛信号，不需要人工看顾。
standard.whenToUse: 长步数训练（>300 步）、无人值守场景。配合智能早停可防止过拟合继续浪费时间。
standard.avoidWhen: 短训练（<100 步）或需要精确控制每步行为时。AutoController 的自动调整会改变原定训练计划。

standard_en.summary: The smart training controller: it adjusts the learning rate, fires early stopping or freezes the text encoder based on loss, CLIP drift, gradient rank and similar metrics. Suited to long unattended runs.
standard_en.effect: Once on, the trainer keeps watching training health in the background and responds to plateau / collapse / convergence signals on its own, with nobody having to babysit it.
standard_en.whenToUse: Long runs (over 300 steps) and unattended sessions. With smart early stopping it keeps overfitting from wasting more time.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Short runs (under 100 steps), or when you need exact control over every step -- the AutoController's adjustments change the plan you set out with.

advanced.principle: 每 ac_warmup_steps 步后启动，每 ac_loss_plateau_window 步评估一次损失趋势、CLIP 漂移、梯度 stable rank。根据多种信号联合决策触发相应干预。
advanced.intervention: 可触发：智能早停（long-term loss 无改善）/ 目标损失早停（窗口平均 loss 达标）/ 学习率衰减（loss 平台期）/ 自动 TE 冻结（指定步数后）/ 自动 LR 调整（GSNR）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 正常收敛训练几乎不会触发任何干预；平台期或过拟合时自动介入，节省无效训练时间。
advanced.tradeoffs: 参数组合复杂，各干预策略叠加时行为难以预测。建议先开启基本版（只开早停+LR衰减），熟悉后再开启 GSNR/CLIP 等高级监控。

advanced_en.principle: Starts after ac_warmup_steps and every ac_loss_plateau_window steps evaluates loss trend, CLIP drift, and gradient stable rank. Joint decisions across multiple signals trigger the corresponding interventions.
advanced_en.intervention: Can trigger: smart early stopping (long-term loss without improvement) / target-loss stop (window-mean loss reached) / LR decay (loss plateau) / automatic TE freeze (after a set step count) / automatic LR adjustment (GSNR).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Normally converging training almost never triggers any intervention; during plateaus or overfitting it steps in automatically, saving wasted training time.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The parameter combinations are complex and behavior is hard to predict when intervention strategies stack. Start with the basic set (early stopping + LR decay only), then enable GSNR/CLIP and other advanced monitoring once familiar.
